title: lulynx SRA2 表征对齐调度

standard.summary: lulynx SRA2 中间层表征对齐 loss：将 DiT 中间层特征与 VAE 编码的 GT latent 对齐，并由本仓 step/decay/plateau heuristic 调度权重；不是已核验的论文 HASTE 复现。
standard.effect: lulynx_sra2_alignment_loss_type 控制对齐方式（cosine/l2/l1）；其他 lulynx_sra2_alignment_* key 控制本仓 heuristic schedule。历史 sra2_haste_* 只作读取 alias。
standard.whenToUse: DiT 训练中想让模型中间表示更好地对齐 VAE latent 空间时。
standard.avoidWhen: 额外计算开销。与 cudagraph/offload 可能冲突。

standard_en.summary: The lulynx SRA2 intermediate-layer representation alignment loss: it aligns DiT intermediate-layer features with the VAE-encoded GT latent, with the weight scheduled by this repository's own step/decay/plateau heuristic; it is not a verified reproduction of the paper HASTE.
standard_en.effect: lulynx_sra2_alignment_loss_type controls how the alignment is measured (cosine/l2/l1); the other lulynx_sra2_alignment_* keys control this repository's heuristic schedule. The historical sra2_haste_* names are read aliases only.
standard_en.whenToUse: In DiT training when you want the model's intermediate representation to align better with the VAE latent space.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It costs extra compute. It may conflict with cudagraph/offload.

advanced.principle: SRA2 在 DiT 的指定层捕获隐藏状态，与 VAE 编码的 GT latent 做对齐；本仓 schedule 只实现 start/stop、linear decay 与 plateau stop。没有找到能唯一对应 HASTE 的权威论文，因此这是 lulynx heuristic，不是 HASTE 论文复现。
advanced.intervention: DiT forward 中捕获中间层特征 → 计算对齐 loss → lulynx heuristic 调度权重 → 加到总 loss。
advanced.expectedImpact: 理论上提升 latent 空间的表示质量。实际效果需 验证。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/sra2_haste_alignment_facade.py → sra2_haste_alignment_loss + haste_alignment_schedule.py；用户配置使用 lulynx_sra2_alignment_*

advanced_en.principle: SRA2 captures hidden states at designated DiT layers and aligns them with the VAE-encoded GT latent; this repo's schedule implements only start/stop, linear decay, and plateau stop. No authoritative paper uniquely corresponding to HASTE was found, so this is a lulynx heuristic, not a HASTE reproduction.
advanced_en.intervention: Captures intermediate-layer features during DiT forward → computes the alignment loss → lulynx-heuristic scheduled weight → added to total loss.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Theoretically improves latent-space representation quality. Actual effect needs verification.
advanced_en.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/sra2_haste_alignment_facade.py → sra2_haste_alignment_loss + haste_alignment_schedule.py; user config uses lulynx_sra2_alignment_*
